directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the saying "Seek to understand others, and you will be understood " You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200.
sample_essay:
"Seek to understand others, and you will be understood." This profound saying highlights the significance of empathy in interpersonal relationships.

To begin with, when we make an effort to understand others, we can build stronger connections. For instance, in a family, if a parent tries to understand a child's perspective on a certain issue, like why they are reluctant to study a particular subject, it can lead to better communication and a more harmonious relationship. In addition, understanding others can help resolve conflicts. In a workplace, when colleagues understand each other's work pressures and limitations, they are more likely to find solutions to problems instead of arguing. Moreover, by seeking to understand others, we can gain new insights. For example, in a cultural exchange, understanding different cultural values can broaden our horizons and enrich our knowledge.

In conclusion, seeking to understand others is not only a way to be understood but also a key to building better relationships, resolving conflicts, and expanding our understanding of the world. We should always keep this in mind and practice empathy in our daily lives.
